title: SDD contract manifest (specs/contracts/manifest.json)
description: Declares the project type, the observable interfaces, which machine contracts exist, and every deliberate deviation from the Equivalence Profile.

artifacts.description: Artifact key (see contract-matrix.json) -> file name inside specs/contracts/.

notApplicable.description: Conditional artifact key -> justification for omitting it.

equivalenceTarget.description: 1 = oracle-conformant (oracle 100% green). 2 = equivalence-verified (also requires a zero-divergence `oracle.cjs diff` / `diff-ui` between two independent builds). Lowering to 1 requires equivalenceTargetDecision.

equivalenceTargetDecision.description: DECISION_LOG id recording the user's decision to certify only L1 (required when equivalenceTarget is 1).

coverageExempt.description: Coverage item (e.g. error:INTERNAL_ERROR, op:getHealth:503) -> why it cannot be exercised black-box.
